title: How does network protection work?
body:
How does network protection work?

Network protection is like an underground tunnel. When you're online:
• Usually: Your phone → Provider → Internet (everyone sees where you're going)
• With network protection: Your phone → Encrypted tunnel → Internet (no one sees!)

It's like invisibility - the internet sees that someone is online, but doesn't know who exactly!

✅ ALADDIN uses network protection to protect all your data.
